name: Krasue
description: A female nocturnal spirit of mainland Southeast Asian folklore, manifesting as a floating disembodied woman's head from which the heart, stomach and other internal organs trail. Belief in the Krasue remains active in rural Thailand, Laos and Cambodia.

aliases.name: Ahp
aliases.meaning: from Sanskrit āpyati, 'to cause to suffer'

origin: Belief in the Krasue and its cognates spans mainland Southeast Asia and the Malay Archipelago, with the strongest contemporary tradition in rural Thailand, Laos and Cambodia. Closely related figures are reported throughout Malaysia, Indonesia (including Bali), the Philippines and parts of Vietnam.
